#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <map>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

class FScanner {
public:
    istream& reader;
    string token;
    FScanner(istream& is) : reader(is) {}

    string nextLine() {
        string s;
        getline(reader, s);
        return s;
    }

    string nextToken() {
        while (!(reader >> token)) {
            reader.clear();
            reader.ignore(numeric_limits<streamsize>::max(), '\n');
        }
        return token;
    }

    int nextInt() {
        return stoi(nextToken());
    }

    double nextDouble() {
        return stod(nextToken());
    }

    char nextChar() {
        char c;
        reader >> c;
        return c;
    }

    long long nextLong() {
        return stoll(nextToken());
    }

    vector<int> iarr(int n) {
        vector<int> mas(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            mas[i] = nextInt();
        }
        return mas;
    }

    vector<double> darr(int n) {
        vector<double> mas(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            mas[i] = nextDouble();
        }
        return mas;
    }

    vector<vector<char>> cmas2(int n, int m) {
        vector<vector<char>> mas(n, vector<char>(m));
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            string line = nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                mas[i][j] = line[j];
            }
        }
        return mas;
    }

    vector<long long> larr(int n) {
        vector<long long> mas(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            mas[i] = nextLong();
        }
        return mas;
    }
};

int main() {
    FScanner fs(cin);
    int n = fs.nextInt();
    string word_str = fs.nextLine();
    // In case the line after reading n is empty, read again
    if (word_str.empty()) {
        word_str = fs.nextLine();
    }
    vector<char> word(word_str.begin(), word_str.end());
    vector<int> vals = fs.iarr(n);
    vector<int> badones(26, 0);
    int m = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
        if (word[i] == word[n - i - 1]) {
            badones[word[i] - 'a']++;
            m++;
        }
    }
    int max_bad = 0;
    bool bad = false;
    int val = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
        if (badones[i] * 2 > m) {
            bad = true;
            val = i;
        }
    }
    if (!bad) {
        long long sum = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
            if (word[i] != word[n - i - 1]) {
                sum += vals[i] + vals[n - i - 1];
            } else {
                sum += max(vals[i], vals[n - i - 1]);
            }
        }
        cout << sum << "\n";
    } else {
        int others = badones[val] - (m - badones[val]);
        vector<int> appr;
        for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
            if (word[i] != word[n - i - 1] && word[i] != ('a' + val) && word[n - i - 1] != ('a' + val)) {
                appr.push_back(min(vals[i], vals[n - i - 1]));
            }
        }
        sort(appr.begin(), appr.end());
        long long ans = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
            if (word[i] == word[n - i - 1]) {
                ans += max(vals[i], vals[n - i - 1]);
            } else {
                ans += vals[i] + vals[n - i - 1];
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < others && i < (int)appr.size(); i++) {
            ans -= appr[i];
        }
        cout << ans << "\n";
    }
    return 0;
}
